label: Bible Study
prompt: For, lo, the _____ is past, the rain is over and gone;
verse: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
note: The next line in the beloved's call — winter's over, the rain is gone, and the flowers are up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet _____, and all the hills shall melt.
verse: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
note: So much harvest the plowman catches up with the reaper — Amos ends with mountains dripping sweet wine.

label: Sunday School
prompt: _____ thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
verse: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
note: Paul notes that 'Honour thy father and mother' is the first commandment that comes with a promise attached.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and _____ you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verse: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
note: Disciples don't apply for the job: Jesus did the choosing and appointing — for fruit that lasts.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all _____ and supplication for all saints;
verse: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
note: The armour of God passage ends not with a weapon but with prayer — watching 'with all perseverance.'
